mapper.insert: INSERT INTO erp_bookstore_content (original_title, author, genre, content_type, schoolyear, summary, keywords) VALUES (#{title}, #{author}, #{genre}, #{contentType}, #{schoolYear}, #{summary}, #{keywords})
INSERT INTO erp_bookstore_item (bcode, content_id, book_title, publisher, keywords) VALUES (#{bcode}, #{contentId}, #{bookTitle}, #{publisher}, #{keywords})

INSERT INTO erp_bookstore_item_del (deleted_by, bcode, content_id, book_title, publisher, keywords) SELECT #{deletedBy}, bcode, content_id, book_title, publisher, keywords FROM erp_bookstore_item WHERE bcode = #{bcode}
INSERT INTO erp_bookstore_item (bcode, content_id, book_title, publisher, keywords) SELECT bcode, content_id, book_title, publisher, keywords FROM erp_bookstore_item_del WHERE del_id = #{delId}
mapper.select:
SELECT bc.content_id, bc.original_title, bc.author, bc.genre, g.codeNm AS genre_name, bc.content_type, ct.codeNm AS content_type_name, bc.schoolyear, s.codeNm AS schoolyear_name, bc.summary, bc.keywords FROM erp_bookstore_content bc LEFT JOIN erp_bookstore_code g ON g.gubun = 'G' AND g.code = bc.genre LEFT JOIN erp_bookstore_code s ON s.gubun = 'S' AND s.code = bc.schoolyear LEFT JOIN erp_bookstore_code ct ON ct.gubun = 'C' AND ct.code = bc.content_type
AND bc.original_title LIKE '%' + #{title} + '%' AND bc.author LIKE '%' + #{author} + '%' AND bc.genre = #{genre} AND bc.schoolyear = #{schoolYear} AND bc.keywords LIKE '%' + #{keyword} + '%' AND bc.content_type = #{contentType}
SELECT TOP 1 content_id FROM erp_bookstore_content WHERE original_title = #{title}

SELECT i.bcode, i.content_id, i.book_title, i.publisher, i.keywords, bc.center_code, bc.state FROM erp_bookstore_item i LEFT JOIN erp_bookstore_item_center bc ON i.bcode = bc.bcode WHERE i.bcode = #{bcode}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO erp_bookstore_item_center (bcode, center_code, quantity, state) VALUES (#{bcode}, #{centerCode}, #{quantity}, #{state})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM erp_bookstore_item_center WHERE bcode = #{bcode} AND center_code = #{centerCode}
mapper.select: SELECT del_id, deleted_at, deleted_by, bcode, content_id, book_title, publisher, keywords FROM erp_bookstore_item_del ORDER BY deleted_at DESC

SELECT ic.bcode, ic.center_code, ic.quantity, ic.state, ic.registered_at, i.content_id, i.book_title, i.publisher, i.keywords FROM erp_bookstore_item_center ic JOIN erp_bookstore_item i ON ic.bcode = i.bcode WHERE ic.center_code = #{centerCode} ORDER BY ic.registered_at DESC
SELECT del_id, deleted_at, deleted_by, content_id, original_title, author, genre, content_type, schoolyear, summary, keywords FROM erp_bookstore_content_del ORDER BY deleted_at DESC
